problem.problem:
Anne is cold. Anne is furry. Anne is rough. Anne is smart. Anne is white. Bob is nice. Bob is rough. Erin is cold. Erin is furry. Erin is nice. Erin is rough. Erin is smart. Erin is white. Erin is young. Fiona is cold. Fiona is furry. All smart things are cold. If Bob is young and Bob is cold then Bob is furry. Young things are cold. If Fiona is rough and Fiona is cold then Fiona is smart. Cold, furry things are white. All rough, nice things are young. If something is white and furry then it is smart.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Fiona is not young.

Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?
Rough($x, bool) ::: Is x rough?
Smart($x, bool) ::: Is x smart?
White($x, bool) ::: Is x white?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?

Facts:
Cold(Anne, True) ::: Anne is cold.
Furry(Anne, True) ::: Anne is furry.
Rough(Anne, True) ::: Anne is rough.
Smart(Anne, True) ::: Anne is smart.
White(Anne, True) ::: Anne is white.
Nice(Bob, True) ::: Bob is nice.
Rough(Bob, True) ::: Bob is rough.
Cold(Erin, True) ::: Erin is cold.
Furry(Erin, True) ::: Erin is furry.
Nice(Erin, True) ::: Erin is nice.
Rough(Erin, True) ::: Erin is rough.
Smart(Erin, True) ::: Erin is smart.
White(Erin, True) ::: Erin is white.
Young(Erin, True) ::: Erin is young.
Cold(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is cold.
Furry(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is furry.

Rules:
Smart($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: All smart things are cold.
Young(Bob, True) && Cold(Bob, True) >>> Furry(Bob, True) ::: If Bob is young and Bob is cold then Bob is furry.
Young($x, True) >>> Cold($x, True) ::: Young things are cold.
Rough(Fiona, True) && Cold(Fiona, True) >>> Smart(Fiona, True) ::: If Fiona is rough and Fiona is cold then Fiona is smart.
Cold($x, True) && Furry($x, True) >>> White($x, True) ::: Cold, furry things are white.
Rough($x, True) && Nice($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: All rough, nice things are young.
White($x, True) && Furry($x, True) >>> Smart($x, True) ::: If something is white and furry then it is smart.

Query:
Young(Fiona, False) ::: Fiona is not young.
